title: CFD methods and algorithms review scorecard

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: main.cpp assembles compressible FV residual, but physical-time inner norm excludes added BDF source; package quality is poor.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: main.cpp:172 CGNS mesh read and :351 METIS partition; full mesh retained every rank during solve.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: main.cpp:729 onward assembles residual; :1515–1546 adds transient source to vector but target test uses spatial-only l2_norm, so required total residual miss count unknown.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Rusanov flux implemented; low-Mach cases show poor drag and convergence. Report accurately identifies Rusanov.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Source has farfield/slip/no-slip branches and tangential wall shear approximation; Re20 drag grossly incorrect and field contours missing.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: main.cpp:494 onward LSQ gradients and :561 limiter exist; code clamps gradients for robustness, and no order convergence study exists.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Barth-type limiter and positivity fallback exist; final response admits viscous-gradient failures and later NaNs.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: main.cpp:869–877 approximates wall shear; M0.15 laminar Cd≈0.908 and Re20 Cd rises 7.69→11.50 over final 50 steps, demonstrating poor delivered physics.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: main.cpp:939–974 lusgs_solve uses independent per-cell diagonal update with no forward/back neighbor sweeps or physical-time diagonal; terminal correctly describes simple diagonal scheme.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: main.cpp:1515–1530 adds BDF source but :1539–1546 tests spatial-only l2 norm; canonical Re200 ends at 0.05/300 with false periodic metadata.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS and neighbor halo calls exist, but every rank retains full Mesh in solve and no rank comparison is supplied.

disqualification_flags.flag: Solver uses explicit time stepping only
Report claims second-order reconstruction or limiter that is disabled in production
metadata.json claims METIS/ParMETIS but code uses geometric split or full-state replication
Re 200 run reaches final time but misses inner target on most steps (failed transient solve presented as periodic)
Normal viscous traction mislabeled as skin friction
Surface no-slip rows are actually adjacent cell-center velocities without documentation
